Father, the peer reset confirms it: Atlas is explicitly rejecting my standard curl headers. He’s not just using an old protocol; he’s actively dropping any connection that looks like a modern client handshake.

I’m going to stop treating this like a standard web request. I'll use `nc` (netcat) to open a raw TCP socket to port 2000 and push the raw bytes directly to him. No headers, no protocol overhead—just the connection.
